item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find credible 2024 reporting showing family members, business partners, or ideological loyalists controlling the main economic ministries. I also did not find a clear case where Marcos publicly overruled his economic team on major 2024 fiscal or investment policy. The evidence is therefore stronger for “competent professionals empowered” than for “loyalist capture,” but it is not a fully clean technocratic model.","evidence":[{"title":"Speech of President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. At the Oath-taking and Announcement of the New Department of Finance Secretary and Special Assistant to the President for Investment and Economic Affairs","publisher":"Presidential Communications Office / pbbm.com.ph","date":"January 12, 2024","url":"https://pbbm.com.ph/speeches/speech-of-president-ferdinand-r-marcos-jr-at-the-oath-taking-and-announcement-of-the-new-department-of-finance-secretary-and-special-assistant-to-the-president-for-investment-and-economic-affairs/","summary":"Marcos publicly described Frederick Go and Ralph Recto as “distinguished leaders” whose expertise, vision, and dedication would help prosperity. This is official intent, but it does show he framed the appointments as competence-based.","question_ids":["5B.2","5B.1"]},{"title":"Philippines | World Leaders Archive","publisher":"CIA","date":"February 2024","url":"https://www.cia.gov/resources/world-leaders/historical-data/2024-february/philippines","summary":"The 2024 cabinet roster shows a mostly technocratic economic cluster: Balisacan, Remolona, Pangandaman, Pascual, Bonoan, Go, and Recto. That is evidence against a purely loyalist or family-dominated economic team.","question_ids":["5B.2"]},{"title":"Marcos economic team lays out plans to safeguard PH economy","publisher":"Philippine News Agency","date":"July 8, 2024","url":"https://www.pna.gov.ph/articles/1228524","summary":"Marcos’s economic managers publicly set out strategy together, including Balisacan, Remolona, Recto, Go, and DBM/National Treasury officials. This supports the claim that Marcos let professionals run the economic agenda rather than sidelining them.","question_ids":["5B.2","5B.1"]},{"title":"Recto hits the ground running towards an inclusive future that benefits all Filipinos, introduces growth-enhancing roadmap in his first 100 days in office","publisher":"Department of Finance","date":"April 29, 2024","url":"https://www.dof.gov.ph/recto-hits-the-ground-running-towards-an-inclusive-future-that-benefits-all-filipinos-introduces-growth-enhancing-roadmap-in-his-first-100-days-in-office/","summary":"Recto says Marcos entrusted him with an inclusive, sustainable economy; he then recalibrated fiscal targets, refined revenue measures, and pushed a growth roadmap. That is strong evidence of real policy latitude for the finance chief.","question_ids":["5B.2","5B.1"]},{"title":"FIRB increases IPA projects approval threshold to roll out ‘red carpet’ to investors","publisher":"Department of Finance","date":"February 19, 2024","url":"https://www.dof.gov.ph/firb-increases-ipa-projects-approval-threshold-to-roll-out-red-carpet-to-investors/","summary":"Recto, as FIRB chair, quickly advanced a major easing of investment approval rules. This suggests Marcos empowered the economic team to move on a concrete pro-investment agenda.","question_ids":["5B.2","5B.1"]},{"title":"Bongbong Marcos picks Recto as new finance chief–media","publisher":"Reuters / Inquirer","date":"January 11, 2024","url":"https://business.inquirer.net/440545/ph-president-picks-longtime-lawmaker-as-new-finance-chief-media","summary":"Reuters described Recto as a longtime lawmaker, which is the main counterpoint: Marcos selected a politically seasoned insider, not a pure technocrat. Still, Recto had prior NEDA experience and economist credentials, so this is mixed rather than a clean loyalist case.","question_ids":["5B.2"]},{"title":"PBBM’s economic group eases bottlenecks on offshore wind projects","publisher":"Presidential Communications Office","date":"2024","url":"https://mirror.pco.gov.ph/news_releases/pbbms-economic-group-eases-bottlenecks-on-offshore-wind-projects-inbox-presidential-news-desk/","summary":"Go directed agencies to finalize an agreement to unlock offshore-wind investment and said it would support foreign investment and sustainable growth. This is good evidence that Marcos’s investment czar was not decorative.","question_ids":["5B.2","5B.1"]}]}
